title: Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
description: Perform any combination of light cleaning duties to maintain private households or commercial establishments, such as hotels and hospitals, in a clean and orderly manner. Duties may include making beds, replenishing linens, cleaning rooms and halls, and vacuuming.

tasks.text: Keep storage areas and carts well-stocked, clean, and tidy.
Carry linens, towels, toilet items, and cleaning supplies, using wheeled carts.
Clean rooms, hallways, lobbies, lounges, restrooms, corridors, elevators, stairways, locker rooms, and other work areas so that health standards are met.
Disinfect equipment and supplies, using germicides or steam-operated sterilizers.
Empty wastebaskets, empty and clean ashtrays, and transport other trash and waste to disposal areas.
Sweep, scrub, wax, or polish floors, using brooms, mops, or powered scrubbing and waxing machines.
Clean rugs, carpets, upholstered furniture, and draperies, using vacuum cleaners and shampooers.
Wash windows, walls, ceilings, and woodwork, waxing and polishing as necessary.
Dust and polish furniture and equipment.
Move and arrange furniture and turn mattresses.
Deliver television sets, ironing boards, baby cribs, and rollaway beds to guests' rooms.
Hang draperies and dust window blinds.
Prepare rooms for meetings and arrange decorations, media equipment, and furniture for social or business functions.
Polish silver accessories and metalwork, such as fixtures and fittings.
Replenish supplies, such as drinking glasses, linens, writing supplies, and bathroom items.
Sort, count, and mark clean linens and store them in linen closets.
Observe precautions required to protect hotel and guest property and report damage, theft, and found articles to supervisors.
Sort clothing and other articles, load washing machines, and iron and fold dried items.
Replace light bulbs.
Request repair services and wait for repair workers to arrive.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Web page creation and editing software
skills.def: Software to develop or edit web sites or individual pages. Examples: Facebook.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows.

skills.name: Instant messaging software
skills.def: Software to enable private communication between participants using networked devices. May include chat rooms or notification services. Examples: Blink.

skills.name: Materials requirements planning logistics and supply chain software
skills.def: Software to manage, monitor, or optimize the flow of goods or services from an origin point to a destination. Examples: Computerized bed control system software.

skills.name: Facilities management software
skills.def: Software to track, monitor, or analyze a facility's assets, space availability, or tenant information. Examples: Computerized maintenance management system CMMS.
